title: Fist develpe branch
summary: This PR introduces a new Java file with critical syntax errors that prevent compilation, and adds a placeholder test file with informal text. The code will not run in its current state. **Not safe to merge** without fixes.

findings.message: Invalid Java method signature: `public static main` is not valid syntax. The main entry point must be `public static void main(String[] args)` to be recognized by the JVM. This prevents compilation.
Typo in method name: `System.out.printlin()` should be `System.out.println()`. This is a compilation error—the method does not exist.
Missing semicolon at end of statement. Java requires statement terminators.
File contains informal text ('i wount to merge this') rather than test code. Appears to be a placeholder or accidental commit. Clarify its purpose or remove if not needed.
